title: Stonewall Was Just The Beginning - Cleveland
description:
Join the Mayday Coalition Project on June 28th for an electrifying afternoon of protest and voter registration. We're carrying on the bold legacy of Stonewall by standing up to policies that are stripping away rights:

• The Trump Administration’s Trans Ban in the military.
• Ohio’s oppressive Drag Ban.
• The relentless rollback of LGBTQIA+ protections.
• Cuts to vital healthcare access for the LGBTQIA+ community.
• Expansions of religious exemptions aimed at denying LGBTQIA+ rights & services.
• The harmful measures of Project 2025.
• Rising discrimination in our workplaces and communities.

This isn't about starting something new—it’s about keeping the flame of freedom and equality burning strong. Your voice matters, your vote matters, and together we can ensure that the struggle for civil rights endures.

Are you ready to stand up and shout for change? Let's make history—because Stonewall was just the beginning.

title: D-Day 81st Anniversary Protest
description:
This Friday June 6th is the 81st anniversary of D-Day. It will be a day of peaceful protest to commemorate the sacrifices of D-Day veterans, and to defend the US Constitution from threats to Democracy — the very democracy our D-Day veterans fought so hard to protect.

The protest is inspired by the “Bonus Army of 1932,” which marched on Washington in the summer of 1932 to successfully persuade politicians to re-instate promised WWI combat bonuses. Just like the Bonus Army of 1932, this Friday’s protests around the country, and on the Burnsville NC Square, will bring the threat of vanishing veterans’ rights to the forefront.

President Donald J. Trump is making quick work of erasing the history and benefits of millions of veterans. Trump’s announcement to rename “Veteran’s Day” to “Victory Day for WWI,” erases the very history of millions of veterans who served after WWI—specifically the millions who served in WWII, Korea, Vietnam, Iraq, Afghanistan, and countless other operations.

Current chaos and cuts to the Veterans Administration have already hobbled the system. Internal VA emails reveal that thousands of the 9 million veterans currently receiving benefits are already enduring gut wrenching cuts. These include loss of cancer treatments, loss of temporary housing for homeless vets, and loss of PACT Act protections to vets exposed to burn pits and other atrocities. Proposed downsizing of VA staff by 70,000 and DOGE-proposed closures of more than17 hospitals will be catastrophic.

Come join us Friday June 6th from 11:30-1:30 at the Burnsville NC Square to support veterans, the US Constitution, and the Declaration of Independence. The event will include readings of both documents, and will include “take-the-oath” ceremonies for any citizen wanting to take the oath to protect and defend the constitution. Anyone who has already taken the oath as part of their job requirement, such as civil servants, politicians, lawyers, judges, or anyone else, may come to re-commit to their oath by re-taking it.

“All US residents, including our bravest —our veterans — are entitled to the inalienable rights of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness,” said Lea Charlton, a co-founder of Mountain Indivisible of WNC. “We should all be committed every day to protecting those rights.” Mountain Indivisible of WNC is sponsoring the event. It organizes pro-democracy events in Mitchell and Yancey Counties, and supports efforts in Avery County.

title: Minnetonka Wednesday Weekly Protest

address_lines: This event’s address is private. Sign up for more details
location.venue: This event’s address is private. Sign up for more details

description:
Our Minnetonka Wednesday Weekly Protest event is a peaceful, legal, nonviolent, family-friendly expression of first amendment rights. We will gather on the public sidewalks and grassy banks along the road margins at the intersection of Minnesota State Highway 7 and County Road 101 in Minnetonka where we will display our hand-made signs in view of evening rush hour traffic at a busy intersection. The convener is experienced in protesting at this location in all kinds of weather. The Highway 7 corridor includes communities with some of the highest voter turnout and civic engagement in the entire country. Residents here span the whole political spectrum of the United States of America, but we all agree that there are no kings in America. In between elections, we remind elected officials that no one is above the law and every elected official is accountable to the people under the Constitution. We affirm that American values of democracy, freedom, and rule of law and opposition to Trump's unaffordable policies are broadly supported in our community. 

The Wednesday 4 June 2025 event is the fifth in a planned long series of Minnetonka Wednesday Weekly Protest events that will continue indefinitely on each Wednesday afternoon through summer, autumn, winter, and into next year as needed until further notice.

description:
Join the Democratic Party of Illinois (DPI), along with our strongest volunteers and supporters, including Governor JB Pritzker and Chairwoman Lisa Hernandez, as we celebrate in the 54th Annual Chicago Pride Parade. The annual parade, which began as a protest march in 1970 following the Stonewall Riots in New York City, has evolved into the city's second-largest parade, featuring nearly 200 entries.

Event Details:

Date: June 29th

Attire: DPI T-shirts will be provided. Colorful and comfortable attire encouraged! This is a wonderful opportunity to show your support for the LGBTQ+ community and to stand together for inclusivity and acceptance. Sign up your friends, family, and your most vibrant self to make this event truly spectacular.

Please RSVP by 25th of june to ensure we have enough materials and space for everyone.

We look forward to celebrating with you!

title: 2025 Federal Budget Phone Bank to Kentuckians
description:
The new House budget and tax plan threatens to cut health coverage, eliminate food assistance for over 100,000 Kentuckians, and implement a federal school voucher scheme (ECCA - Educational Choice for Children Act), all to fund tax cuts for the wealthy. If implemented, this would mark the largest funding cut to both Medicaid and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) in our state's history.

Join us on Wednesday, June 4th, 7:30 - 9:00 pm EDT for a phone bank to Kentuckians. 

We will start with a brief training on our phone bank platform & review the impact of these tax cuts for the wealthy. Then we will call & talk with our fellow Kentuckians about the proposed budget & why ECCA and cuts to Medicaid & SNAP are bad for Kentucky. We will also be asking our fellow Kentuckians to take action with us to oppose these cuts in the federal budget.
